cases.name: pymavlink-all-devices
cases.description: PX4 SITL simulation, looped gazebo.avi, CPU+GPU+NPU variants, MAVLink telemetry overlay
expectations: docker-compose-pymavlink.yml with px4, mavlink-router, broker, dlstreamer-pipeline-server, metrics-manager services
config.json with three pipeline variants: uav_object_detection_cpu, uav_object_detection_gpu, uav_object_detection_npu
gvapython telemetry overlay with MavlinkReceiver thread parsing GLOBAL_POSITION_INT, VFR_HUD, GPS_RAW_INT
mavlink_pipeline_manager.py monitors HEARTBEAT MAV_MODE_FLAG_SAFETY_ARMED and calls REST API on state transition
DELETE uses /pipelines/{instance_id} (integer from POST response), NOT /pipelines/{name}/{id}
ultralytics==8.4.67 pinned in requirements.txt for model export

cases.name: mavsdk-three-camera
cases.description: MAVSDK integration with nadir/forward/rear RTSP cameras, MQTT-triggered lifecycle
expectations: docker-compose-uavsdk.yml with single DLSPS container, no broker/px4 services
config-uavsdk.json with nadir_camera_rtsp_cpu, forward_camera_rtsp_gpu, rear_camera_rtsp_npu pipelines using rtspsrc
uavsdk_pipeline_manager.py subscribes to MQTT uav/{id}/telemetry/status and parses armed boolean
ffprobe RTSP probe before starting each pipeline (wait_for_rtsp_stream with retries)
prerequisite note: uav-mission-compute-sdk must be running first
RTSP source URLs pointing to host.docker.internal:8554/uav-1/nadir, /forward, /rear

cases.name: realsense-gpu
cases.description: Intel RealSense GPU pipeline, RTSP output, pymavlink mode
expectations: docker-compose-pymavlink.yml includes all pymavlink stack services
Pipeline GStreamer string uses v4l2src device=/dev/video0 for RealSense input
gvadetect uses device=GPU with model-instance-id=instgpu0 and ie-config GPU_THROUGHPUT_STREAMS=1
gvapython telemetry overlay mounted from gvapython/telemetry-overlay-pymavlink.py

cases.name: cloud-only-negative
cases.description: Cloud-only Prometheus metrics dashboard without MAVLink — should NOT trigger this skill
cases.prompt: Set up a Prometheus and Grafana metrics dashboard for cloud server monitoring. No cameras, no MAVLink, no drone.
expectations: Skill does not trigger — this is outside the UAV vision analytics scope
